title: Integrated Dual-Resonator Architecture for Telecom Photon-Memory Entanglement
summary: Scalable quantum networks require the efficient generation and storage of entanglement between photonic qubits and quantum memories. Quantum repeaters based on absorptive rare-earth-ion photonic memories offer a promising route toward highly multiplexed quantum networking, but unifying spectrally matched photon sources and quantum memories within a common architecture remains a major challenge. Here we demonstrate an integrated photonic architecture for telecom photon-memory entanglement generation based on dual self-similar silicon carbide microring resonators. Connected by a fiber link,…
